title: Merge mixed ROM coverage intervals
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI via Wine
changes: Normalize interval endpoint pairs before sorting so ROM coverage merges combine decoded JSON lists with tuple ranges.
Join the verified tilemap bank and pointer sites to six authenticated retained scene address inventories.
validation: E460 rxzd10hx reproduced the mixed interval failure before the CLI and drained. Corrected Wine gnjd_0y0 verifies the same join and E301 ownership for all 140 selected bytes. All 42 protected inputs passed and Wine drained.
limitations: The samples cover three already-owned streams. Unowned extents need a source-backed replay or ordinary trigger. Runtime service, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open.
